fields.value: Kids Trolley Sipper Water Bottle with Strap is a fun, practical and easy-to-carry drinking bottle designed for children, boys and girls. This kids water bottle features a trolley-style design that makes carrying convenient for school, travel, outings, picnics and everyday use. The compact design is suitable for children who need their water bottle easily accessible throughout the day. Made from plastic, this reusable sipper bottle is designed for regular daily use.
